listen_interface.description: Network interface (e.g., 'eth0') or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces to listen on for PXE/DHCP boot traffic.

http_listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the HTTP boot server to (e.g., '192.168.1.1' or '0.0.0.0' to serve all interfaces).

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP boot service.

boot_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the root directory containing all boot assets.

kernels_dir.description: Subdirectory under boot_root where kernel images are stored.

initrds_dir.description: Subdirectory under boot_root where initrd/initramfs images are stored.

kernel_args_default.description: Default kernel command-line arguments applied to all hosts unless overridden.

download_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a client to download a file before aborting the request.

syslog_enabled.description: Enable or disable sending logs to a remote or local syslog daemon.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when syslog is enabled (e.g., 'local0', 'daemon').

syslog_server.description: Optional hostname or IP:port of remote syslog server (e.g., '192.168.1.10:514'). Leave empty to use local syslog only.

supported_protocols.description: List of boot protocols the daemon supports. Valid values: 'pxe', 'http', 'tftp', 'https'.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the target host.

mac.description: MAC address (optional for HTTP-only boot; required for PXE).

initrd.description: Initrd/initramfs filename (relative to boot_root/initrds_dir). Leave empty if none.

kernel_args.description: Custom kernel arguments for this host (overrides kernel_args_default).
